messages:
Priya (Support): heads up — multiple customers reporting 500s from hosted inference API starting ~09:12 UTC. Error shows as QUOTA_GATEWAY_FAIL 500. Sample request ids: rq_79f3, rq_7a22, rq_7b33. Customers say they were previously seeing 429s but now get 5xx. Any ideas?

sre-bot: [ALERT] prod-us-east-1 quota-gateway 5xx spike above threshold (5m avg 12%). PagerDuty triggered.

Evan (SRE): thanks. Can you paste a few raw response headers + a pod log trace? Also was there any routing or deploy around that time? @Lena can you check routing rules?

Priya (Support): pasted logs below — raw response from edge: 

```
x-request-id: rq_79f3
x-upstream-service: quota-gateway
error: upstream timeout
upstream_status: 500
trace: quota-gw->kv-store (timeout after 2s)
```

pod logs (quota-v1):
```
[2024-06-23T09:12:14Z] ERROR quota-gateway request_id=rq_79f3 failed to fetch quota: timeout fetching keys from kv-store: context deadline exceeded
[2024-06-23T09:12:14Z] ERROR quota-gateway return status=500 to client
```

Also noticed in the proxy logs that ~30% of requests were hitting quota-v1 (legacy) at the spike while the rest hit quota-gateway.

Lena (Platform): I can see a routing change at 09:10 UTC — we started a header-based canary for X-Client-Version -> route to quota-gateway. The edge strips X-Client-Version for some endpoints, so for those requests the rule falls through and sends traffic to quota-v1. quota-v1's KV client isn't resilient to transient timeouts and bubbles a 500. The new quota-gateway returns 429 for quota breaches and 503 on backend timeouts; quota-v1 just returns 500. I'm rolling the canary back now.

Josh (Eng): quick mitigation plan: 1) roll the routing canary to 0% to stop misroutes, 2) hotfix quota-v1 to map kv timeouts -> 429 when the context indicates a rate check, otherwise 503, and 3) add a fast-fail timeout on quota-v1's KV client so it doesn't hang and trigger 500s. I can push a patch and restart the deployment.

Priya (Support): reproduction note: requests with Authorization header preserve X-Client-Version and route correctly. If the header is missing (e.g., some client SDKs strip it) the routing rule misses and falls back. Steps to repro: 
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Client-Version: canary" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -> route=quota-gateway
2) curl -H "X-Client-Version: canary" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -> route=quota-v1 (edge strips Authorization in this path)

Evan (SRE): rollback routing first. @Lena cut canary to 0% and post status. After rollback, let's set temporary circuit-breaker on quota-v1 to fail fast so gateway fallback works.

Lena (Platform): canary -> 0% at 09:22 UTC. Observability: 5xx rate dropped within one minute. Pushing envoy config rollback now.

sre-bot: [RECOVERY] prod-us-east-1 quota-gateway 5xx rate back under threshold.

Priya (Support): customers confirmed degraded but recovering. Creating incident ticket and sending update.

Josh (Eng): deployed hotfix image to quota-v1 (registry/redwood/quota-v1:20240623-hotfix) and restarted pods as extra safety. Command used: 
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/quota-v1 quota-v1=registry/redwood/quota-v1:20240623-hotfix
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/quota-v1
```
Patch PR: https://git.redwood/repo/quota/pull/521 — adds explicit mapping of KV timeouts to 429/503 and a 500->4xx fallback for rate-limiter code paths.

Evan (SRE): postmortem action items: 
- Fix routing predicate to not rely on headers that edge may strip (use session or path-based fallback).
- Add resilience (shorter timeouts + retries) to quota-v1 KV client and align status mappings with quota-gateway.
- Add guardrail in edge: if upstream quota returns an error with type "rate" prefer 429, never 500 for quota decisions.
I'll create a runbook entry for this misroute pattern and schedule a follow-up. Assigning to @Lena and @Josh. ETA 48h.

support-bot: incident INC-2024-324 created, severity: S2, assignees: Lena, Josh, Evan.

Priya (Support): thanks all — I'll send templated customer updates and mark affected accounts. Will close once runbook + PR merged and routing fix is live. :thumbsup:
